name: Kharan Mighthammer
summary: The King says Kharan Mighthammer is held prisoner in Blackrock Depths. You are sent to find him, perhaps in a prison.

sections.title: A Prisoner in the Depths
sections.body: The way into Blackrock Depths begins with a search for a prison. Kharan Mighthammer is being held somewhere within, and the King has sent you to find him. His whereabouts remain unknown, so the prison is the place to look.

faq.answer: Kharan Mighthammer is a prisoner held in Blackrock Depths.
Kharan is being held in Blackrock Depths, perhaps in a prison.

faq.q: What does the King want me to do?
faq.answer: The King wants you to travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer.
